lines.en: Theo, look at this electricity bill. It must have been a mistake, because we were away for most of March.
lines.pt: Theo, olha esta conta de luz. Deve ter sido um erro, porque passamos a maior parte de março fora.

lines.en: That is impossible. They must have counted the wrong dates, or someone must have entered extra units.
lines.pt: Isso é impossível. Devem ter contado as datas erradas, ou alguém deve ter lançado unidades a mais.

lines.en: Or the meter might have been broken. It could have been reading too high for weeks.
lines.pt: Ou o medidor pode ter estragado. Pode ter estado marcando alto demais por semanas.

lines.en: I doubt it. The technician must have checked it in January, so it should have been fine.
lines.pt: Duvido. O técnico deve ter conferido em janeiro, então deveria estar tudo bem.

lines.en: Then the company must have mixed our flat up with the neighbour’s. They would have sent two bills.
lines.pt: Então a empresa deve ter confundido nosso apartamento com o do vizinho. Teriam enviado duas contas.

lines.en: Maybe, but the neighbour shouldn’t have paid it without checking. He must have been in a rush.
lines.pt: Talvez, mas o vizinho não deveria ter pago sem conferir. Ele deve ter estado com pressa.

lines.en: You needn’t have worried so much, though. I called the helpline, and they said they would investigate.
lines.pt: Você não precisava ter se preocupado tanto, aliás. Liguei para a central e disseram que vão investigar.

lines.en: Good. We should have kept a record of the readings. If we had, this would have been much quicker.
lines.pt: Ótimo. Deveríamos ter guardado um registro das leituras. Se tivéssemos, isso teria sido bem mais rápido.

lines.en: True. Anyway, the clerk at the counter must have seen this error many times. Let’s ask her.
lines.pt: Verdade. Enfim, a atendente do balcão deve ter visto esse erro muitas vezes. Vamos perguntar a ela.

lines.en: Excuse me, we believe there has been a mistake on this invoice. Could you check it, please?
lines.pt: Com licença, acreditamos que houve um erro nesta fatura. A senhora poderia conferir, por favor?

lines.en: She is checking now. Apparently, the previous tenant must have left a debt, and it was added to ours.
lines.pt: Ela está conferindo agora. Pelo visto, o inquilino anterior deve ter deixado uma dívida, que foi somada à nossa.

facts.label: Deduzindo erros
facts.sub: It must have been a mistake. The meter might have been broken. We should have kept a record. You needn’t have worried.

facts.label: must have + particípio
facts.sub: Use must have + particípio quando tem quase certeza do passado: It must have been a mistake. Em português: “deve ter sido”. Não use must been.

facts.label: might / could have
facts.sub: Use might have ou could have quando não tem certeza: The meter might have been broken. Em português: “pode ter sido”. É mais fraco que must have.

compare.ask: It must have been a mistake.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “deve ter sido um erro” e “pode ter estragado”.

compare.us: Em inglês, usamos modal + have + particípio: It must have been a mistake. The meter might have been broken.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.

pages.title: A mistake on the bill · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cold morning in Denver. Beth opens the mail at her kitchen table. One envelope contains a very high bill. Theo comes over with his coffee. They read the numbers again and again. Neither of them can understand it.

“Theo, look at this electricity bill. It must have been a mistake, because we were away for most of March.” says Beth. “That is impossible. They must have counted the wrong dates, or someone must have entered extra units.” says Theo. “Or the meter might have been broken. It could have been reading too high for weeks.” says Beth.

paragraphs: “Excuse me, we believe there has been a mistake on this invoice. Could you check it, please?” says Theo. “She is checking now. Apparently, the previous tenant must have left a debt, and it was added to ours.” says Beth. Beth and Theo walk to the service counter. The clerk looks at the screen carefully.
